# A9 Voice

> A9 Voice is a Windows app for dictation and meeting notes: hold Ctrl+Space to type with your voice in
> any app, and record Teams or Zoom calls with no bot joining. Made by Atlas9 LLC. Transcribe (dictation)
> is free; Notes (meetings) is $49 once after a 30-day trial. Data stays on the user's PC.

## Product
- [Home](https://a9voice.com/): what it does, questions and answers
- [Free dictation for Windows](https://a9voice.com/free-dictation/): hold Ctrl+Space and talk, no account, no word limit, speech models that run on your PC
- [Features](https://a9voice.com/features/): the full tour, measured numbers, comparison table
- [Pricing](https://a9voice.com/pricing): Transcribe free, Notes $49 once
- [About](https://a9voice.com/about): Atlas9 LLC, how the numbers were measured, contact
- [Changelog](https://a9voice.com/changelog/): every version, newest first
